scope: Theorem 4.5 (Point-endpoint determination) of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k ≥ 2, and put Pi = X(y + it, t), 0 ≤ i ≤ k. Every intermediate point and every edge of this chain is algebraic over the differential field generated by P0, Pk and the analytic coefficient A(t) in dp ∧ dΘ = A(t) dy ∧ dt. For each fixed k, finitely many jets suffice. The assertion persists under translation and analytic continuation.
